items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: Ivory Garner for Pre-Sax. Ain't that what his name? Oh my God. He was playing sax, Chinese.

ctx.x: So who was in that band with Johnny and all that?

Let me see. Nothing I remember. Let's see. I couldn't remember. Ivory Garner for Pre-Sax. Ain't that what his name? Oh my God. He was playing sax, Chinese. Now them's only two. Let me see. Who else can I think of? Who was the leader? Well, Buddy P.T. was the leader. He played trumpet at that time. He was a trumpet player. That's the only thing I can remember. Buddy and Ivory Garner and Chinese. Them's only one of them.
Them's only one of the bands who played bass?
